root_cause.text: The error handling in `airoha_qdma_rx_process()` conditionally returned the page pool fragment only when `q->skb` was NULL, but when processing non-linear fragments for an existing skb, an error could leave the fragment unlinked to the skb and thus not returned to the pool, causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff removes the `else` branch and unconditionally calls `page_pool_put_full_page(q->page_pool, page, true)` in the error path, and the commit message explains that "the page_pool fragment will not be linked to the skb so it will not return to the pool in the airoha_qdma_rx_process() error path" and that the fix partially reverts commit `d6d2b0e1538d` which introduced the conditional logic.

This directly fixes the reported memory leak. Thus, the function after this commit no longer contains the vulnerable construct.
